# jsonata-jvm-compiler

> jsonata-jvm-compiler is a Java 21 library that compiles [JSONata](https://jsonata.org) expressions
> into native JVM bytecode at runtime. Each expression is parsed, optimised, translated to Java
> source, compiled in-memory, and returned as a ready-to-call, thread-safe `JsonataExpression`.
> Repeated evaluation is around 39× faster than interpreter-based alternatives (e.g. IBM's
> JSONata4Java) on a realistic analytical benchmark. All cases in the official JSONata test suite
> pass. Apache-2.0.

Use it when you evaluate the same JSONata expression many times and want native-bytecode throughput
instead of an interpreter — compile once at startup, evaluate on the hot path. Requires a Java 21
**JDK** (the in-memory compiler needs `javac`), Jackson Databind 2.18+, and joni 2.2+. Maven
coordinates: `io.github.vlad-public-code:jsonata-jvm-compiler:1.0.5`.

Key facts:
- **Compile then evaluate:** `factory.compile("Account.Order.Product.Price * 1.2")` →
  `JsonataExpression`; `expr.evaluate(jsonNode)` → `JsonNode`. The instance is thread-safe and
  reusable; don't call `compile()` on the hot path.
- **Batch compile:** `factory.compileAll(List.of(...))` runs the expensive `javac` step once for the
  whole batch — ~35× faster than compiling 200 expressions one at a time, and uses a fraction of the metaspace.
- **Bindings:** inject `$name` values and `$name(...)` functions per-evaluation
  (`JsonataBindings`) or permanently (`assign` / `registerFunction`); per-evaluation wins on a name
  clash.
- **JSONata libraries:** `factory.compileLibrary(definitionExpression)` → `JsonataLibrary`, with
  `getFunctions()` → `Map<String, JsonataBoundFunction>` and `getConstants()` → `Map<String, JsonNode>`.
  A definition is ordinary JSONata that binds names and returns the ones to export
  (`["gross", "format", "vatRate"]`); each lands in one map or the other by what it evaluated to.
  Write a set of bindings once in JSONata — recursive, mutually recursive, closing over private
  helpers — then apply it to any expression with `getFunctions().forEach(expr::registerFunction)`
  and `getConstants().forEach(expr::assign)`. A definition must be self-contained: a name it neither
  binds nor takes from the standard library must be supplied through
  `JsonataLibraryOptions.bindings`, or the build fails.
- **Two exceptions:** `JsonataCompilationException` (bad expression) and `JsonataEvaluationException`
  (bad input / runtime error, including the `U1001` timeout from `setTimeout`).

## Documentation

- [Documentation]({{ '/' | absolute_url }}): overview, requirements, getting started, bindings, performance, thread safety, and the compile→optimize→translate→load architecture.
- [Getting started]({{ '/#getting-started' | absolute_url }}): add the dependency, compile an expression (single or batch), and evaluate against JSON.
- [Bindings]({{ '/#bindings' | absolute_url }}): per-evaluation vs permanent bindings, `JsonataBoundFunction`, and the function-signature syntax.
- [JSONata libraries]({{ '/#jsonata-libraries' | absolute_url }}): write a set of bindings once as a JSONata definition expression and apply it to any expression — exported functions and constants, private helpers, signatures, and lifetime.
- [Performance]({{ '/#performance' | absolute_url }}): the ~39× benchmark vs JSONata4Java and how to reproduce it.
- [Architecture]({{ '/#architecture' | absolute_url }}): the pipeline and package structure (`parser`, `optimizer`, `translator`, `runtime`, `loader`).
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/vlad-public-code/org.json-kula.jsonata-jvm-compiler): code and README. Apache-2.0.

## Built-in function references

- [Numeric functions]({{ '/numeric.md' | absolute_url }}): implementation notes for `$number`, `$round`, `$random`, `$formatBase`, `$formatNumber`, `$formatInteger`, `$parseInteger`.
- [String functions]({{ '/string.md' | absolute_url }}): implementation notes for `$string*`, `$length`, `$substring*`, `$match`, `$replace`, `$split`, `$join`, `$pad`, `$base64*`, `$encodeUrl*`, and more.
- [Date/time functions]({{ '/datetime.md' | absolute_url }}): implementation notes for `$now`, `$millis`, `$fromMillis`, `$toMillis` (ISO 8601).

## Related projects

- [tracked-json](https://vlad-public-code.github.io/org.json-kula.tracked-json/): a Jackson `JsonNode` wrapper that tracks each node's absolute `JsonPointer` through every navigation; includes RFC 9535 JSONPath and RFC 6902 JSON Patch.
- [Valem](https://vlad-public-code.github.io/org.json-kula.valem/): a deterministic reactive computation runtime for AI-generated structured data models, built on this compiler. [llms.txt](https://vlad-public-code.github.io/org.json-kula.valem/llms.txt).
- [Valem sandbox](https://valem.run/): the hosted, zero-install demo.
